comment: C-first source-distinct monster-to-hero life-drain candidate. monsters.h defines a wraith AT_TUCH/AD_DRLI 1d6; mhitu.c:hitmu routes a landed attack through uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping to mhitm_ad_drli, whose monster-to-hero branch may call losexp after rn2(3) and Drain_resistance checks. The v17 drain-life scroll cases instead enter read.c:seffect_drain_life -> drain_item and drain a wielded object. Current B81 unresolved cases contain no wraith attack. The recipe is independently designed and frozen before JS comparison; C must establish whether the wraith reaches its touch attack.
